description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application, providing basic endpoints such as a welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message at the root endpoint.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation, preserving the request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' status indicating application health.
